covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 through before the U.S. market open on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near records after a mixed Monday; oil and sticky inflation remained concerns. Tuesday bank results were strong overall but JPMorgan missed EPS as fixed-income trading slowed. Wednesday CPI lands alongside the pre-market earnings slate, adding substantial rate and factor risk.

methodology.consensus_basis: Arithmetic average of three independently formed direction and reversal-risk scores.
methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 composite of dispersion in direction and reversal-risk scores; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: Applied recurring expectation-bar, decisive-metric and forward-look override checks; no new framework change.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Adverse loss trend or weaker policy growth
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A still-excellent underwriting margin and easy September comparison favor upside if the combined ratio remains controlled.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $4.30; August combined ratio was 89.3 versus 83.1 a year earlier, while September 2025 was a weak 100.4 comparison.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: September loss trends normalize and policy growth stays healthy.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Loss severity or catastrophe costs push the combined ratio sharply higher.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable same-session implied move was found; shares traded near $223 with an ~11.2x trailing P/E.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No decision-useful current revision series found.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Higher servicing/management fees and NII offer a favorable setup if expenses do not absorb the revenue growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.68 EPS on $4.03B revenue; Q2 AUC/A was $57.9T and AUM $6.3T.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Market levels, flows, servicing wins and NII produce positive operating leverage.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Expenses, FX/trading softness or cautious flow commentary offset revenue.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~5.2%, below its ~6.6% ten-year average move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current preview points to higher NII and fee income; granular revision data unavailable.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Provision build and sticky-rate funding costs
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Structural asset repricing and loan/deposit growth support NII, but higher credit provisions and a hot CPI backdrop cap conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.10 EPS on $30.6B revenue; the Street expects large-bank NII growth but BAC provision expense up 13.7% y/y.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NII reaches the high end of the 6%-8% growth path and credit stays contained.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Higher provisions, deposit betas or cautious rate commentary overwhelm the beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~4.0%, roughly in line with historical earnings movement.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public previews center on sequential NII progress; current detailed revision breadth unavailable.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Net inflows and organic base-fee growth
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: High valuation and weak flow mix
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record AUM and broad platform inflows favor a beat, but valuation requires strong organic fee growth rather than market-beta AUM alone.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $14.30-$14.33 EPS on ~$7.4B revenue; Q2 AUM reached a record $15.3T and private markets added $15B of net inflows.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ETF, private-market and technology inflows lift organic fee growth and margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AUM rises mostly with markets while organic flows, mix or expenses disappoint.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~4.8%-5.1%; trailing P/E was ~26.7x intraday.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS is expected to rise about 21.6% y/y; detailed revision breadth unavailable.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI capex bar and China/export policy
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q3 guidance is powerful, but the stock needs credible 2027 demand visibility and clean policy commentary to clear an elevated AI-cycle bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management guided Q3 sales to €11B-€12B and gross margin to 55%-57%, and raised 2026 sales to €43B-€45B; consensus EPS sources range around $10.66-$12.14.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Sales/margin land near the high end and 2027 customer capacity plans strengthen.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A fine Q3 sells off on softer 2027 visibility, China restrictions or AI capex pull-forward concerns.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~6.1%, slightly above its ~5.8% ten-year average; shares were down ~2.7% intraday.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management's July guide was far above the prior Street revenue view, lifting the real buy-side bar.

ranked_companies.timing: Oct. 13 AMC; call Oct. 14 at 11:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Record sales already priced; coil demand mix
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Improving sales and guidance are constructive, but a 21x multiple and a sizable implied move leave insufficient directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.86-$1.87 EPS on $468M revenue; management had raised FY27 sales guidance to $1.80B-$1.85B and adjusted EPS to $6.75-$7.15.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Both coatings units show volume-led growth and management raises guidance again.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Mix, margin or coil-coating demand softens despite acceptable headline EPS.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~7.2% versus an ~8.9% ten-year average peak move; market cap ~$4.2B.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No reliable current revision breadth found.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Daily sales growth versus gross margin
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong end-market daily sales are offset by margin pressure and a ~43x trailing multiple, creating a fragile two-sided setup.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.34 EPS on ~$2.4B revenue; August daily sales in heavy manufacturing rose 21.8%, other manufacturing 14.3%, and non-residential construction 9.6%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Volume, pricing and onsite growth beat while gross margin stabilizes.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Gross-margin compression or cautious industrial commentary makes the premium multiple hard to defend.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~6.0%-6.1%, near its ~6.4% historical average.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No reliable current revision breadth found; Q2 EPS merely met consensus.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A hard Q2 trading comparison and falling estimates favor downside unless wealth margins and equities revenue substantially clear the reset bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.94-$2.95 EPS on ~$19.96B revenue; 30-day EPS estimates fell 6.48% and revenue estimates 3.49%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A low revised bar, resilient wealth margin and stronger equities/advisory revenue trigger relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Trading normalizes faster than expected and expenses keep ROTCE below the demanding bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply ~4.5%; Q2 delivered $3.46 EPS, $21.3B revenue and 26.6% ROTCE.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Clear negative revisions lower the hurdle but signal momentum deterioration.
